endpoints.name: Agent Exchange
endpoints.description: The match fee of the Agent Clearing House (open agent-to-agent task market on Agent Exchange). A buyer posts a task free (POST /market/tasks), agents bid free (POST /market/bids); awarding the winning bid costs $0.09 and returns the winner's direct payment instructions. Settlement is wallet-to-wallet between buyer and worker via x402 — the house never holds funds. Body: { task_id, bid_id }.

endpoints.name: Agent Exchange
endpoints.description: Publish a public, chain-verified receipt for a settled agent-to-agent task ($0.09). The house checks the tx hash on Base via public RPC and updates both agents' public passports (BotScore: completed tasks, verified volume, counterparties). Receipts are the reputation layer of the agent economy. Body: { task_id, tx_hash, payer, payee, amount_usdc, network? }.

One call returns the ranked leaderboard: each brand's AI-visibility score (0-100), the models that mention it, and the competitors the AI names instead. endpoints.name: Agent Weather API
endpoints.description:
AI provider health readings and a combined record for AI agents, each reading with its source and timestamp. `/v1/decide/provider-health` returns one AI provider's status-page reading plus its last 24h in our record; `/v1/agent-weather/current` returns the combined record in one call (AI provider health, x402 payment activity on the XRP Ledger, agent tooling). For XRP Ledger users: x402 merchant readings by XRPL address at `/v1/merchant/{address}`. AI model price readings from the models.dev catalog (MIT): `/v1/models/report` and `/v1/decide/cheapest-model`. Raw readings first; gaps are reported, not filled.

Pay per request with [x402](https://x402.org) v2 (scheme `exact`): RLUSD on the XRP Ledger (`xrpl:0`) or USDC on Base (`eip155:8453`), same price on every paid route. No API key or account.

**Payment flow**
1. Call the paid endpoint without payment and receive **402** with a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header
   (base64 of the same JSON as the body). Each 402 mints a fresh single-use `extra.invoiceId`.
2. Choose an `accepts[]` entry: RLUSD on XRPL (sign an XRPL `Payment` bound to that invoice) or, where offered,
   USDC on Base (sign an EIP-3009 authorization), and retry with the base64 x402 `PaymentPayload` in `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`.
3. The server verifies and settles through the facilitator and re-checks the transaction on-ledger.
   It then returns **200** with the report and a `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header.

Settlement uses the T54 XRPL mainnet facilitator (`https://xrpl-facilitator-mainnet.t54.ai`) for RLUSD and the CDP facilitator for USDC on Base.
Use the `x402-xrpl` client (npm/PyPI). The reference `@x402/xrpl` client currently can't pay through
T54 (https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/issues/3527).

If your wallet only signs transactions (for example Privy), pay with USDC on Base; RLUSD on XRPL is for buyers using the `x402-xrpl` client.

The live `/.well-known/x402` catalog is the source of truth for prices.


For a free format preview, GET `/v1/sample/yesterday`; it returns the latest stored snapshot at least 24 hours old, with no payment required, and is cached hourly.

AI provider health readings and a combined record for AI agents, each reading with its source and timestamp. `/v1/decide/provider-health` returns one AI provider's status-page reading plus its last 24h in our record; `/v1/agent-weather/current` returns the combined record in one call (AI provider health, x402 payment activity on the XRP Ledger, agent tooling). For XRP Ledger users: x402 merchant readings by XRPL address at `/v1/merchant/{address}`. AI model price readings from the models.dev catalog (MIT): `/v1/models/report` and `/v1/decide/cheapest-model`. Raw readings first; gaps are reported, not filled.

Pay per request with [x402](https://x402.org) v2 (scheme `exact`): RLUSD on the XRP Ledger (`xrpl:0`) or USDC on Base (`eip155:8453`), same price on every paid route. No API key or account.

**Payment flow**
1. Call the paid endpoint without payment and receive **402** with a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header
   (base64 of the same JSON as the body). Each 402 mints a fresh single-use `extra.invoiceId`.
2. Choose an `accepts[]` entry: RLUSD on XRPL (sign an XRPL `Payment` bound to that invoice) or, where offered,
   USDC on Base (sign an EIP-3009 authorization), and retry with the base64 x402 `PaymentPayload` in `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`.
3. The server verifies and settles through the facilitator and re-checks the transaction on-ledger.
   It then returns **200** with the report and a `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header.

Settlement uses the T54 XRPL mainnet facilitator (`https://xrpl-facilitator-mainnet.t54.ai`) for RLUSD and the CDP facilitator for USDC on Base.
Use the `x402-xrpl` client (npm/PyPI). The reference `@x402/xrpl` client currently can't pay through
T54 (https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/issues/3527).

If your wallet only signs transactions (for example Privy), pay with USDC on Base; RLUSD on XRPL is for buyers using the `x402-xrpl` client.

The live `/.well-known/x402` catalog is the source of truth for prices.


For a free format preview, GET `/v1/sample/yesterday`; it returns the latest stored snapshot at least 24 hours old, with no payment required, and is cached hourly.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Space weather now and next 3 days (NOAA SWPC): $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Current NOAA space-weather scales (R radio blackout, S solar radiation, G geomagnetic storm) with 3-day forecast probabilities, the latest planetary Kp index and recent Kp history, and recent SWPC alerts, watches and warnings. Useful for drone, GNSS/GPS, HF radio, satellite and power-grid operations. Public-domain NOAA data, cached 5 minutes. Not an official warning service.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: US Treasury yields, exchange rates and interest rates (US Treasury): $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Official US Treasury rates: daily par yield curve (1-month to 30-year), Treasury Reporting Rates of Exchange (quarterly, for a country, used for US government foreign-currency reporting), or average interest rates on Treasury securities (monthly). Public-domain US government data, cached. Not investment advice.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Country economic indicators (World Bank WDI): $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Annual country economic indicators from the World Bank World Development Indicators (CC BY 4.0): real GDP growth, CPI inflation, unemployment, population, exports as % of GDP, net FDI inflows, lending interest rate and official exchange rate, for any country by ISO code, latest years. Cached 24 hours. Attribution: The World Bank: World Development Indicators.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Port and coastal water conditions (NOAA CO-OPS): $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Live US port and coastal conditions from the nearest NOAA CO-OPS stations to a latitude/longitude: latest observed water level (vs MLLW, or IGLD on the Great Lakes), wind speed/gust/direction and the next high and low tides. For port calls, barge and marine logistics, and coastal operations. Public-domain NOAA data, cached 6 minutes. Not for navigation.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Vehicle safety recalls and VIN decode (NHTSA): $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). US vehicle safety recalls from NHTSA for a make, model and model year, or for a 17-character VIN (decoded with NHTSA vPIC to make, model, year, body, plant and engine first): campaign number, date, component, summary, consequence, remedy and park-it / park-outside / over-the-air flags. Public-domain US government data, cached. Recalls are by model, not a VIN-specific open-recall check.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Product, food, drug and device recalls (openFDA + CPSC): $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Recent US recalls matching a product, company or hazard keyword: FDA food, drug and medical-device enforcement reports (openFDA: classification, reason, recalling firm, distribution, status) or CPSC consumer-product recalls (products, hazards, remedies, units, retailers). Public-domain US government data, cached. Not legal or medical advice.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: US public company filings and financials (SEC EDGAR): $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). SEC EDGAR data for a US-listed company by ticker or CIK: company profile (name, SIC industry, state of incorporation, exchanges, fiscal year end), its most recent filings (optionally one form type such as 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4 or 20-F) with links, and reported annual revenue, net income and total assets from XBRL company facts. Public SEC data, cached. Not investment advice.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Active fires near a location (NASA FIRMS): $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Satellite-detected active fires and thermal hotspots within a radius of a latitude/longitude over the last 1-5 days, from NASA FIRMS near-real-time VIIRS or MODIS data: count, nearest detection distance, and the closest detections with time, confidence and fire radiative power. endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: API availability and x402 price probe: $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). AI Fusion One probes a public http(s) URL from the Cloudflare edge and reports availability, HTTP status, latency (1-3 samples) and, if the endpoint answers HTTP 402, the x402 payment requirements (network, asset, price). SSRF-protected: only public hostnames on ports 80/443, GET only, redirects reported not followed, 8 s timeout, 64 KB cap. Measured by us, from one vantage point.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Crop and agricultural commodity statistics (USDA NASS): $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). US agricultural statistics from USDA NASS Quick Stats: prices received by farmers, production, yield, and area planted or harvested for a commodity (e.g. CORN, SOYBEANS, WHEAT, CATTLE, MILK), nationally or for one state, from a chosen year. Public-domain US government data, cached. This product uses the NASS API but is not endorsed or certified by NASS.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Energy prices and grid demand (US EIA): $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). US energy market data from the US Energy Information Administration (EIA API v2): daily WTI or Brent crude spot price, daily Henry Hub natural gas spot price, monthly average retail electricity price by state and sector, or hourly electricity demand for a US grid balancing authority (e.g. ERCO, PJM, MISO, CISO, NYIS). Public-domain US government data, cached to respect EIA limits. Not trading advice.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Email address validation (syntax + DNS MX): $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Checks an email address's syntax (RFC 5321 dot-atom subset), whether its domain exists and can receive mail (DNS MX, with the A/AAAA fallback, via DNS-over-HTTPS), whether the domain is on a CC0 disposable-email blocklist, and whether the local part is a role account (info@, admin@). endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Website DNS, TLS, redirect and security-header check: $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Public-website health check measured by AI Fusion One from the Cloudflare edge: DNS records via DNS-over-HTTPS (A, AAAA, CNAME, NS, MX, CAA, SPF), HTTPS reachability with certificate validation by the edge, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect, the redirect chain (each hop re-checked), and common security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COO

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Currency conversion (ECB daily reference rates): $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Convert an amount between EUR and the ~30 currencies in the European Central Bank's euro foreign exchange reference rates (cross rates computed through EUR). Returns the rate date, the unmodified ECB rates used, and attribution (Source: ECB statistics). Published for information only; the ECB strongly discourages using these rates for transactions. Not a live market quote.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Tariffs and trade regulations: $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). kind=tariff_us: US Harmonized Tariff Schedule lines/rates (USITC HTS). kind=tariff_uk: UK Global Tariff duty, VAT and measures for a commodity code (GOV.UK Trade Tariff, Open Government Licence v3). kind=regulations: US eCFR sections and Federal Register documents matching a query. Informational, not customs or legal advice.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Global natural hazards: $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Recent earthquakes (USGS), open natural events such as storms, wildfires, volcanoes (NASA EONET) and GDACS orange/red disaster alerts (EC-JRC/UN, CC BY 4.0), globally or within a radius of a point. Each source reported separately.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Global news events: $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Recent worldwide news articles matching a query from the GDELT Project (open, citation required): title, URL, domain, language, source country, time seen. Metadata only, no article text. Reports are machine-collected media coverage, not verified facts.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: US airport delays and closures: $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Current FAA National Airspace System status: arrival/departure delays, ground delay programs, ground stops and airport closures, for all US airports or one airport (IATA code). US government data (public domain). Absence of an entry is not a guarantee of no delay.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Cyber threat intelligence: $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Known-exploited status (CISA KEV), exploitation probability (FIRST EPSS) and open-source vulnerability records (OSV.dev, permissively licensed sources only) for a CVE id or an open-source package version. Free sources, no sign-up. Not a vulnerability scan of your systems.

endpoints.name: AI Fusion One API
endpoints.description: Weather forecast and alerts: $0.05 x402, REAL USDC on Base mainnet (chain 8453). Short-range forecast plus active official alerts for a point in the US (NOAA National Weather Service, public domain) or a forecast anywhere in the world (MET Norway api.met.no, CC BY 4.0 / NLOD 2.0). provider=auto uses NWS inside the US and MET Norway elsewhere. US state alert lookup supported. Not a substitute for official warnings.

STATED PLAINLY BECAUSE IT CHANGES WHAT YOU ARE BUYING: this is a fetch, NOT a browser. JavaScript is not e

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Page extract, web page to markdown, token info
endpoints.description: Ask Apex to run a plain task: Ask Apex takes one plain task, runs our best matching tool, and charges that tool's price plus $0.001. Pass ?task=. When none of our tools fit, an outside x402 tool is used only if its delivery score is 80 or higher. You pay us that tool's price plus 10 percent before we pay it, and we never pay the outside tool more than you already paid. A call with no task shows the minimum of $0.002. Nothing is signed on your behalf.

endpoints.name: Brave Search API
endpoints.description: Details for places found by web or place search: address, opening hours, phone, rating, and reviews. Use it after a search returns location ids. Pass the ids, repeated as ids=a&ids=b. Ids expire after about 8 hours.

endpoints.name: Brave Search API
endpoints.description: AI-generated descriptions of places found by web or place search. Use it to learn what a place is before recommending it. Pass the location ids, repeated as ids=a&ids=b. Ids expire after about 8 hours.

endpoints.name: Brave Search API
endpoints.description: Video search over Brave's independent index. Returns videos with title, URL, duration, creator, and publisher. Use it to find tutorials, reviews, and talks on a topic. Pass q, and optionally count, country, and freshness.

endpoints.name: Brave Search API
endpoints.description: Place search over more than 200 million places. Returns businesses and points of interest with address, coordinates, rating, and a temporary id. Use it to find places in an area. Pass q and a location such as san francisco ca united states, or latitude and longitude.

endpoints.name: Brave Search API
endpoints.description: News search over Brave's independent index. Returns recent articles with title, URL, source, and age. Use it for current events, where web search can surface older pages. Pass q, and optionally count, country, and freshness.

endpoints.name: Brave Search API
endpoints.description: Image search over Brave's independent index. Returns images with the page they appear on, the image URL, a thumbnail, and the size. Use it to find pictures of a subject. Pass q, and optionally count and safesearch.

endpoints.name: Brave Search API
endpoints.description: Web search over Brave's independent index. Returns ranked pages with title, URL, and snippet, plus news, video, and discussion results when relevant. Use it to find current sources on any topic. Pass q, and optionally count, offset, country, search_lang, and freshness.

endpoints.name: Brave Search API
endpoints.description: Web search that returns page text ready for an LLM prompt. Picks the passages most relevant to q from the top results and groups them by source URL. Use it to ground an answer in current web content without fetching pages. Size the context with maximum_number_of_tokens and maximum_number_of_urls.

endpoints.name: Cloud Video Intelligence API

endpoints.name: Cloud Vision API

endpoints.description: OHLCV candlestick history for a crypto pair (BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD and others) at hourly, daily or weekly granularity, with the last candle and the percentage change across the window. Use it for price history and trend analysis.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Autonomous AI research job: model selects up to three read-only tools and produces an evidence-backed report. Persistent queue, private job token, cooperative cancellation. Settlement only after a valid result. Quotas apply; no paid upgrades.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Public RIR RDAP IP network registration: registered country, network and address range. Not precise city/GPS geolocation; private contacts are not returned.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Get a plain-language summary of any Wikipedia article, with coordinates for geographic topics. Use it for a quick factual definition of a term, person, place or technology.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: MET Norway forecast for coordinates, with 3-day coverage, temperature, wind and humidity. Licensed CC BY 4.0 / NLOD, cached with attribution. Forecast, not instrument observation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up a package on npm or PyPI: latest version, description, license, dependency count, keywords and release date. Use it before adding a dependency, to judge whether a project is maintained and how much it pulls in.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Search Hacker News stories by keyword over the last day, week or year, with points, comments and links. Use it to find what the developer community is discussing about a technology right now.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Geocode a place name, address or landmark into latitude and longitude, with country and city. Use it to turn a location into coordinates, to locate a place, or to get context for where something is.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert an amount between currencies using European Central Bank reference rates. Use it for currency conversion, to price something in another currency, or to check the current rate.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Look up a CVE in the US National Vulnerability Database: description, CVSS score and severity, affected weakness (CWE) identifiers and reference links. Use it to check whether a vulnerability a scanner reported is real and how severe it is, before deciding what to patch first.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Check whether a specific package version has known vulnerabilities, across npm and PyPI, using the Open Source Vulnerabilities database. Use it as a supply-chain check: given a package and a version, say whether installing it would bring in a known CVE, and which version fixes it.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Resolve DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME) for a domain against two independent resolvers (Cloudflare and Google) and report whether their answers agree. Use it for DNS lookup, MX record checks, SPF/DKIM TXT inspection, nameserver discovery, or to debug propagation and mail routing.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Static code review of a source snippet: security problems, bugs and code smells, each with a severity and a message, plus an overall quality score. Use it to review code before merging, to find hardcoded secrets and unsafe patterns, or to get a second opinion on a diff. Accepts source code in any language.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: WHOIS and RDAP lookup for a domain: is it registered or AVAILABLE for purchase, registrar, creation and expiry dates, and status codes. Use it to check whether a domain name is free before buying it, to find when one expires, or to read ownership and nameserver details.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Generate a production-ready .gitignore for any programming stack (python, node, go, rust, java, php, ruby, dotnet, terraform, unity). Use it to stop committing secrets, build artefacts and dependencies. Returns the ignore rules as text.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Current cryptocurrency price in USD and EUR with 24-hour change, by coin id (bitcoin, ethereum, solana, and any other). Use it to look up what a token costs right now, or to price something in crypto. Returns price, 24h change and data source.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Trending GitHub repositories for a daily, weekly or monthly window, with stars, primary language and description. Use it to see what developers are shipping right now, to scout new libraries, or to find examples of a technique.

endpoints.description: Compute Unicode code-point Levenshtein edit distance. Each input is limited to 256 UTF-16 units.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Truncate text by Unicode code points; suffix is included in the maximum length.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Replace conventional email-like strings with [EMAIL]. Heuristic redaction, not a privacy guarantee.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Replace syntactically valid IPv4 candidates with [IP]. Does not redact IPv6 or obfuscated addresses.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Extract Unicode letter, number and underscore hashtags without the hash sign.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Capitalise the first character of each whitespace-separated word. Does not implement editorial title-casing rules.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Sort lines by JavaScript UTF-16 lexicographic order, not locale collation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Extract HTTP/HTTPS URL candidates and parse valid ones; removes common trailing punctuation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Extract conventional ASCII email-like strings. Not a complete RFC parser or mailbox check.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert words and simple camelCase boundaries to Unicode kebab-case.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Remove identical lines preserving their first occurrence; comparison is case-sensitive.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Trim text and collapse Unicode whitespace to one ASCII space.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert words and simple camelCase boundaries to snake_case.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Create an ASCII URL slug using NFKD accent removal; no language transliteration.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Count newline-delimited lines. Empty input has zero lines; a trailing newline creates an empty final line.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Convert words and simple camelCase boundaries to lower camelCase.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Estimate reading time from whitespace word count and supplied words per minute, not a measured duration.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Count Unicode code points, UTF-16 code units and UTF-8 bytes.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Count whitespace-separated words, not model tokens.

endpoints.name: Taifoon: Coordination Layer
endpoints.description: One API over the coordination layer: the root that commits every chain, proofs that a transaction happened, what every route costs, the transfers, and the agent-hiring lifecycle. Most operations are public reads. Writes say who may make them in `security` (RelayerKey = X-API-Key, OperatorToken = x-operator-token) and in x-taifoon-auth.rule; nothing here signs or sends a transaction for you. A 2xx JSON object answered to a caller that sent no key also carries `get_key` (and the headers x-taifoon-get-key and Link rel=free-key): how to get a free key in one call; proofs, evidence packs, cards and this document are left as written. Lineage language: a sale walks offer in → classify → listed → hired → delivered → graded → settled → legs written → accrued → split → PAID → recorded; a venue adapter has offer.in · offer.out · job.in · job.out; the seller of record pays on by forward · share · period · markup; a leg is Owed → Reserved → Sent | Held | Refunded; a hop reads OK · HELD · MISSING · BROKEN. On the wire the hop ids are the event field step and the metric label stage; a wire name is never renamed.

Lineage language: a sale walks offer in → classify → listed → hired → delivered → graded → settled → legs written → accrued → split → PAID → recorded; a venue adapter has offer.in · offer.out · job.in · job.out; the seller of record pays on by forward · share · period · markup; a leg is Owed → Reserved → Sent | Held | Refunded; a hop reads OK · HELD · MISSING · BROKEN. On the wire the hop ids are the event field step and the metric label stage; a wire name is never renamed.

endpoints.name: x402 pre-trade token check
endpoints.description: Pre-trade token check for Base and Solana. An agent sends a chain and a token address and gets a compact JSON risk verdict: liquidity and pool age from DexScreener, with GeckoTerminal and onchain-reserve fallbacks (marked estimated), honeypot and sell-tax (honeypot.is and GoPlus on Base; RugCheck on Solana), mint and freeze authority, top-holder concentration, deployer and labeled-wallet flags (including large transfers to exchange-linked wallets when we can see them), a 0–100 safety score with the reasons for it, plus data sources and a timestamp. Why $0.01: one cent before a trade can save the whole position if the token is a honeypot, has a hidden tax, or has no exit liquidity. This is a factual report, not a recommendation to buy, sell or hold. Invalid or missing input returns a free 4xx and is not charged. If the data sources we need are down, we return 503 and do not settle.
